label: s32_st_iris_the_second_box
title: The Second Shoebox
summary: Callback to archive_iris_index, and the payoff for the one thing Iris has never described to anyone as anything but a quirk. She does not explain why it matters. What she needs is not to be believed -- it is to be accompanied -- and the scene is careful not to say so. Threshold lowered from 20 to 14 for the same reason as theo_admits_it.
